p.i: A revelation given at Independence, Jackson Co., Missouri, 30 April 1832, through Joseph Smith Jr.

chapter.li: LEChapter83 Verse1 Truly thus says the Lord: In addition to the laws of the church, concerning women and children who belong to the church, who have lost their husbands or fathers, VerseEnd Verse2 women have claim on their husbands until they are taken, VerseEnd Verse3 and if they are not found transgressors, they remain upon their inheritances. VerseEnd Verse4 All children have claim upon their parents until they are of age, VerseEnd Verse5 and after that, they have claim upon the church, or in other words the Lord’s storehouse, for inheritances. VerseEnd
